title: Adnah
summary: Raleigh names Adnah in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Adnah had the commaund of three hundred thousand of IEHOSAPHAT his men of warre. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XIX, §. VII, sig. 312b–313a
